ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $AC=BC$, point $C(2,0)$, and point $B(0,4)$. The graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x} (k\ne 0)$ passes through point A. What is the expression of the inverse proportion function?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $AD\perp x$-axis at D, then $\angle ADC=90^\circ$, \\
$\because \angle ACB=90^\circ, AC=BC$, \\
$\therefore \angle BCO+\angle ACD=90^\circ$, \\
$\because \angle BCO+\angle CBO=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle ACD=\angle CBO$, \\
In $\triangle BOC$ and $\triangle CDA$, \\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle BOC=\angle CDA=90^\circ \\
\angle ACD=\angle CBO \\
AC=BC
\end{array}\right.$, \\
$\therefore \triangle BOC\cong \triangle CDA\left(AAS\right)$, \\
$\because$ the coordinates of point C are $(2,0)$, and the coordinates of point B are $(0,4)$, \\
$\therefore OC=2, OB=4$, \\
$\therefore CD=OB=4, AD=OC=2$, \\
$\therefore OD=OC+CD=6$, \\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point A are $(6,2)$, \\
Substituting the coordinates of point A into the inverse proportional function $y=\frac{k}{x}$, we get $k=2\times 6=12$, \\
$\therefore$ the analytic expression of the inverse proportional function is $\boxed{y=\frac{12}{x}}$;

method.method_draft: From the image, note that B is on the positive y-axis, C is on the positive x-axis, A is to the right of C and above the x-axis, and segment CA forms the other leg of the right isosceles triangle. From the text, use B(0,4), C(2,0), angle ACB = 90°, and AC = BC. Drop a perpendicular from A to the x-axis at D. Compare right triangle BOC with right triangle CDA: both are right triangles, the angle at C/D relation follows from complementary angles around the right angle at C, and AC = BC. Thus the triangles are congruent, giving CD = OB = 4 and AD = OC = 2. Since C is at x = 2, D is at x = 2 + 4 = 6, so A = (6,2). Because the inverse proportional function y = k/x passes through A, k = xy = 6·2 = 12, so the function is y = 12/x.

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $AC=BC$, point $C(2,0)$, and point $B(0,4)$. The graph of the inverse proportion function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ $(k\ne 0)$ passes through point $A$. What is the expression of the inverse proportion function?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $AD\perp x$-axis at $D$, then $\angle ADC=90^\circ$, \\
$\because \angle ACB=90^\circ,\ AC=BC$, \\
$\therefore \angle BCO+\angle ACD=90^\circ$, \\
$\because \angle BCO+\angle CBO=90^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle ACD=\angle CBO$, \\
In $\triangle BOC$ and $\triangle CDA$, \\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle BOC=\angle CDA=90^\circ \\
\angle ACD=\angle CBO \\
AC=BC
\end{array}\right.$, \\
$\therefore \triangle BOC\cong \triangle CDA\left(AAS\right)$, \\
$\because$ the coordinates of point $C$ are $(2,0)$, and the coordinates of point $B$ are $(0,4)$, \\
$\therefore OC=2,\ OB=4$, \\
$\therefore CD=OB=4,\ AD=OC=2$, \\
$\therefore OD=OC+CD=6$, \\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point $A$ are $(6,2)$, \\
Substituting the coordinates of point $A$ into the inverse proportional function $y=\frac{k}{x}$, we get $k=2\times 6=12$, \\
$\therefore$ the analytic expression of the inverse proportional function is $\boxed{y=\frac{12}{x}}$.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a rectangular coordinate system, point B is on the positive y-axis, point C is on the positive x-axis, and point A is located to the upper right of C; line segments BC and CA form triangle ABC, and the inverse proportional function curve passing through point A is also drawn in the figure. Reasoning: From the problem statement, B=(0,4), C=(2,0), so OB=4, OC=2. Draw AD through A perpendicular to the x-axis at D. Because ∠ACB=90°, ∠BCO+∠ACD=90°; also because △BOC is a right triangle, ∠BCO+∠CBO=90°, therefore ∠ACD=∠CBO. △BOC and △CDA are both right triangles, and have ∠BOC=∠CDA=90°, ∠CBO=∠ACD, BC=AC, so △BOC≅△CDA. Thus CD=OB=4, AD=OC=2. Since the x-coordinate of C is 2, and A is on the right side of C, the x-coordinate of D is 2+4=6, A=(6,2). The inverse proportional function y=k/x passes through A, therefore k=6×2=12. So the function expression is y=12/x.
